p15.prompt: A frame from a feature film: PLUM, the broad masked robber in a chalk-striped mustard-yellow three-piece suit, standing in the aisle of a luxury 1920s Pullman dining car, rapping straight into the lens, caught at the top of a big shrug, both shoulders up, gloved palms open and turned up at waist height, head cocked to one side. His mask and suit are exactly as in the attached reference image, the mask copied exactly from PLUM's close-up: plum rib-knit wool over the head and neck, no holes, a large white wool ring round the face, one small rounded red felt triangle high over his LEFT eye, on the right of the picture at two o'clock. Black leather gloves, no skin. Medium shot from the end of the car, eye-level, 85mm, mahogany panelling and white tablecloths compressed behind him. Warm light from small shaded table lamps, golden fields streaking past the windows. Beside him a porter in a white jacket holds out a silver tray with one boiled egg, gazing at nothing. 35mm film, fine grain. 16:9.
p15.why: A long-lens shrug of "what did you expect" from the vain one, with a single egg served to him like it's the Crown Jewels, plays passive wealth as table service.

p16.place: the ring of a smoky boxing gym
p16.prompt: A frame from a feature film: all six masked robbers, PLUM, BOTTLE, CRIMSON, MARINE, RUST and SILVER, packed close together inside the canvas ring of a smoky 1920s boxing gym, all staring straight up into the lens mid-rap, five of them with a gloved fist thrust straight up overhead in perfect unison, BOTTLE's fist only halfway up, a beat late. Their masks and suits are exactly as in the attached reference image, the masks copied exactly from the close-ups: rib-knit wool over each whole head and neck, no holes, a large white wool ring round each face, one small rounded red felt triangle high over each man's LEFT eye, on the right of each face in the picture at two o'clock. Black leather gloves, no skin. High angle from above the top rope, 35mm, the group filling the frame so every mask reads large. Hard daylight shafts from tall windows behind, cutting through chalk dust and cigarette smoke; heavy bags and ropes fall to shadow. Shot on 35mm motion-picture film, fine grain. 16:9.
p16.why: The hungry-revolution line gets a raised-fist salute from the whole gang, and one man being late gives the joke away without turning it into a cartoon.
